notes: Both supplied *into*s placed on the bare directional accusatives שְׁעָרָיו / חֲצֵרֹתָיו under rule 33 (the contract's own *to your mountain* case) rather than on בּוֹא under rule 44; the second colon has no verb at all, so the noun-based reading is the one that covers both. Competing reading named in the gates unit.
Both connectives (*And*, *and*) are added: the Hebrew is asyndetic throughout, and rendered material stands between them so they are two units (rules 14, 2).
ASV margin *a thank-offering* read and set aside (rule 38).
